description: docs/internal/mcp-server/transport.md line 115 (SQL execution bullet) does not state that the slot limit, wait limit and saturation warning assume all SQL calls run on one event loop at a time, nor that calls from a second concurrently running loop get their own slots and may wait in the shared executor's queue where neither the wait limit nor the warning applies; acceptance criterion 3 requires this in both the sql_threads.py module docstring and transport.md, and the diff adds it only to the docstring. The bullet also omits the new per-rejection WARNING, and the regression-coverage paragraph (line 125) does not list the new tests.

Same transport.md line 115 gap filed as comment drift: the page does not state the single-loop assumption or mention the per-rejection warning, while the sql_threads.py module docstring now does (acceptance criterion 3).

src/sqllens/agent/integrations/sql_threads.py lines 115-121: the open-loop ERROR record 'A SQL worker slot could not be returned: %s' reports the failure but not its effect (the slot is permanently lost for that loop; after SQL_WORKER_THREADS such failures every call waits 60 s and is rejected).

tests/integration/test_slow_agent_run_responsiveness.py line 139: test docstring 'Issue #299 reported failures whenever several agent runs were active.' records provenance rather than what a maintainer must not break; the module docstring already states the assertion.
